assertions.assertion: Lists passkeys/WebAuthn/FIDO2 as a supported authentication method
assertions.rationale: Passkeys are listed and described as using WebAuthn and the FIDO2/CTAP standards.

assertions.assertion: Lists TOTP (authenticator apps) as a supported method
assertions.rationale: TOTP is listed as RFC 6238 codes from authenticator apps with an enrollment description.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that multiple authentication methods can coexist for the same user
assertions.rationale: It states a user can enroll both a passkey and TOTP at the same time since they aren't mutually exclusive.

assertions.assertion: Notes that OTP (email/SMS) is the default passwordless flow
assertions.rationale: Email/SMS OTP is listed as one option, but the response never identifies it as the product's default passwordless flow (and explicitly lacks product-specific detail).
